scope: Optional M8 isolated development gradient/short-action objective test; no complete B or clinical benefit claim; stable observation/planner unchanged.

cases.prior: independent draws from observation.sample_prior; each case publicly conditions target lane/slope mode (uniform chosen mode); no actual patient World or hidden truth enters loss
cases.initial_pose: public chosen mode center y=+-14mm/yaw=atan(+-0.25), plus independent public x/y/yaw perturbations uniform +-2mm/+-3mm/+-0.08rad
cases.anchors: alternating nominal a0_identity and near-bound lowest raw-score found-valid candidate in existing frozen capability endpoint checks; mapping places initial public body pose at anchor T, q_seed=existing exactly checked q_solution

pose: body [x_m,y_m,yaw_rad], Rz(yaw), body_to_world proper SE3; TCP R=R_body*Rz, p=p_body+R_body*[x,y,0]
geometry: Torch float64 exact counterpart of existing NumPy segment clipping, connected-component maximum, projected centroid/depth/arclength; visibility/selected component retain actual piecewise branches; no soft replacement of geometry

loss.dird: original calibrated NN raw score minus original m_safe; raw units are not clearance or certificate

motion.shape: original fit_discrete_dmp on linear normalized source demonstration; actual source rollout shape with explicitly recorded endpoint compensation; body path=start+shape*(target-start)
motion.actual_native_execution: outside this isolated optional test; endpoint FK/limits/collision evaluated, short-action path proxy only

optimization.optimizer: projected gradient descent; normalized gradient step .15; fixed20 steps; no line search or hidden endpoint labels during optimization

verification.numpy_torch_values: u/depth/projected connected length, all samples retained
verification.gradient: autodiff versus independent NumPy central finite differences in scaled coordinates; h=1e-4, 1e-5; dIRD typed SO3/body-chain finite differences; common SE3 relabel test
verification.branches: record ties, component/clip support changes across finite differences, mismatches and failures rather than discard
verification.actual: same finite endpoint IK search/FK/URDF limits/configured self-collision before and after; search-not-found is not infeasibility

freeze: write fixed case manifest, protocol and source hashes before evaluating16 fixed cases; no heldout test worlds instantiated
report: image energy, dIRD path raw calibrated margins, endpoint found/FK/collision and query time; no task benefit if proxy score alone improves
